snippet.title: Better Super Mario Sunshine Online | Official Release Trailer (10 player)
snippet.description:
Better Super Mario Sunshine Online(BSMSO) is a mod that Enhances the Original Sunshine Experience by allowing up to 10 players to Join in one Session! 

With 2 Gamemodes, 15 FULLY Custom Characters, and Quality of Life Features, this is THE way to enjoy a Vacation with your Friends!

Game Download! - https://gamebanana.com/mods/697699

Join the Team Elements Discord for Setup Help! -  
https://discord.gg/2zxdHyz9ct

Join the BSMSO Discord for Updates and People to play with! - 
https://discord.gg/s5HebuxqX2

#sunshine #supermario #modding #online #dolpin #supermario64 #excoopdx
